interface.longDescription: Open The Onlinesourdough Method (OSM) from the Codex sidebar. Connect the separate official Notion plugin, follow the source setup steps and open Context, Docs, Skills and Memory from your dashboard. Established alternative providers remain supported. Twenty-two shared skills help with writing, code, content and reviewed delivery.
